The one-agent comparison follows because same-valuation worlds in each initial S5 block share identical modal theories at each stage, each strict local step deletes a whole valuation type, and a locally unchanged block never restarts. value.rationale: The new initial-S5 witness closes the exact n-stage lower bound left open by a general-model directed-cycle witness, under the stringent requirements of only two agents, a fixed one-letter modal-depth-one formula, and equivalence blocks of size at most two. The one-agent resource threshold min(n,2^r) demonstrates a genuine sharp arity transition: one atom permits at most two rounds for one S5 agent but unbounded rounds for two, identifying precisely how two independent local information partitions encode an arbitrarily long cascade. This is a motivated model-size and logical-resource boundary, not an arbitrary table or routine numeric improvement.
